title: Allowance Applied Webhook
description: Account-anchored invalidation fired after a seller applies a change to a live media buy under a seller-held change term (change_terms[] with holder seller). Experimental in AdCP 3.3 (media_buy.seller_adjustment_allowances). Registered through sync_accounts notification_configs with event_types: ["media_buy.allowance_applied"]. The payload is not authoritative: receivers verify signing, dedupe by idempotency_key, then repair through get_media_buys, which lists the change in applied_adjustments[]. Push is optional; polling sees every applied adjustment.

idempotency_key.description: Random fire identifier reused across retries. Receivers dedupe within the authenticated sender scope.

notification_id.description: Logical notification identifier. Always equals adjustment_id; re-emissions retain it.

adjustment_id.description: The applied adjustment. notification_id equals it.

revision.description: The media buy revision the adjustment created.

reason.description: Short machine-readable reason code, the same shape as the reason on an account change record.

action.description: The term's action. The values are in get_media_buys applied_adjustments[], never in this payload.

examples.description: The seller released budget it forecast it could not deliver
